column2: Your (imported) film isn't on the others' games yet: when you load the reel, each of them gets a question with the film's size ([Y] yes, [U] no); without enough disk space, they read it in the chat. The film goes to those who say yes, and the show starts as soon as everyone has received enough of it: the rest arrives during the screening.
During the show, the room's lights go out; at the end they come back on and the emergency exit opens.
